title: Audit-chain OTLP Span
description: Single OTLP span emitted by `fcp-audit` on every chain append. One span per audit entry; spans live under namespace `fcp.audit.entry`.

name.description: Span name is constant; one span per audit entry.

kind.description: Audit-append is an internal operation; no client/server semantic applies.

message.description: Set to the `reason_code` attribute when code = ERROR; empty otherwise.

start_time_unix_nano.description: Nanoseconds since Unix epoch, sourced from the HLC physical component at the moment of audit append.

end_time_unix_nano.description: Start time + 1000 (a synthetic 1 microsecond duration). Audit append is a point event.

fcp.audit.entry.entry_id.description: 32-hex-char prefix of the BLAKE3-256 canonical-body hash.

fcp.audit.entry.hlc.description: Hybrid Logical Clock encoded as `{l}.{c}` where `l` is the OTLP nanosecond physical component.

fcp.audit.entry.hlc.l.description: HLC physical component encoded for OTLP as UTC nanoseconds (`entry.hlc.physical_ms * 1_000_000`).

fcp.audit.entry.reason_code.description: Structured reason enum value (e.g. RevokedBeforeUse, QuorumNotMet, Expired, Ok).

fcp.audit.entry.quorum_height.description: BLS-aggregate quorum signing height; 0 when no aggregate quorum sig is attached.

fcp.audit.entry.sig_kinds_present.description: Non-empty subset of proof kinds attached to this entry. Hybrid Ed25519+ML-DSA (Phase N) appends emit both.

fcp.audit.entry.prev_hash_prefix.description: First 16 hex chars (8 bytes) of the previous entry's hash. Sufficient for chain-linkage tracing in dashboards without leaking the full hash.

resource.description: Resource attributes per OpenTelemetry semantic conventions. Populated by the exporter from the host runtime context.
